links.source_location: base.html provides a server-side flash-stack that these AJAX editors cannot use
login duplicates the base CSS custom-property palette inline because it deliberately does not extend base.html (no sidebar/session chrome pre-auth), so palette edits must be made twice
same game record fields: title, platform, status, prog_story, cover_url, hours_hltb
both prefill a shared modal for edit mode
same create-vs-edit modal populated from a tojson-serialized record, hidden id field distinguishes insert from update
both are inline style.display collapse toggles
dxModal instructions: run dxdiag, save all info, drop the txt
identical show/hide panel + active-class tab switcher, duplicated instead of shared in base.html
module-level dxComponents array written by parseDx, read by openBuildModal
same team.data / team.members shape (pokemon, held_item, move1..4, sprite_url)
nature table documents the same nature_effects mapping team_form renders in its nature select
items_data['items'] datalist fed by the items JSON the editor writes
mega_map and roster list both come from data/roster_ma.json
mechanic select is empty in HTML and populated from regulation.mechanics so new regulations need no template change
mechanics vocabulary (mega/tera/zmove/dynamax) edited in regulation_editor, consumed here
both autofill a form from Pokemon data, but one calls PokeAPI directly from the browser while the other goes through the Flask /api/pokemon proxy
same /api/pokemon/<name> call, one for validation, one for sprite/ability/move autofill
fetch('/api/pokemon/'+name) used as an existence check
categories drive the damage calculator multipliers; abilities are global, regulation-independent
both feed the damage calculator: abilities supply multipliers, moves supply BP/category
parallel {name: {category, modifier|effect, desc}} dictionary schema edited through the same UI shape
delete button onclick emitted into row HTML
same filter+sort+innerHTML row-builder over an Object.entries dictionary
same table renderer with inline description editing
both mirror the visual editor state back into the raw-JSON textarea that the POST actually submits
items editor exposes the same archive form
same archive banner exists in moves and items editors (/pokemon/mosse/archive, /pokemon/oggetti/archive)
window._pokeapiValidated flag set by fetch, read by addMove
addMove refuses unless window._pokeapiValidated; warning says Champions values may differ from standard PokeAPI
two independent client-side notification widgets that both bypass the base.html flash-stack
archive current roster before switching regulation; restore saves the current one as backup first
roster_file/moves_file/items_file are editable metadata; each editor loads and saves only that regulation's files
module-level _deleteId set by confirmDelete, consumed by deleteRegulation
delete button disabled when reg.teams_count > 0; deletion also removes roster/moves/items files
